newsitem.title: UK: Samsung Group appoints new Europe head.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Group appoints new Europe head.

text.p: Korean engineering to electronics giant Samsung Group said on Thursday it had appointed Cegill Shin as president of Samsung Europe.
Shin, 57, is president of Samsung Corporation, the trading arm of the Samsung Group.
Shin will be based at Samsung Europe's headquarters in London and will work on decentralising the group's decision-making in Europe, the company said in a statement.
Samsung has recently concentrated on giving a more local content to its European businesses, drawing on local labour and locally supplied components.
